### Security Standards

 Configure Operating System to prevent enumeration of administrator accounts during elevation (disable registry key HKLM\SOFTWARE\Microsoft\Windows\CurrentVersion\Policies\CredUI\EnumerateAdministrators).
 Implement Group Policy to disable enumeration of admin accounts on elevation.

iterations.rule_text:
title: Potential AdFind Execution
id: d234d10e-868c-4126-85da-ef0909f282d1
status: experimental
description: Detects execution of adfind.exe with suspicious command-line arguments commonly used for Active Directory reconnaissance.
author: Shakedown
date: '2026-10-27'
tags:
- attack.discovery
- attack.t1087
logsource:
  category: process_creation
  product: windows
detection:
  base_image:
    Image: adfind.exe
  cmd_showdel:
    CommandLine|contains: -showdel
  cmd_sdna_nosacl:
    CommandLine|contains:
    - -sdna
    - -nosacl
  cmd_security_desc:
    CommandLine|contains:
    - -sddl
    - -sddc
    - -owner*
  cmd_computed_attrs:
    CommandLine|contains:
    - parentrdn
    - objrdn
  condition: (base_image and (cmd_showdel or cmd_sdna_nosacl or cmd_security_desc or cmd_computed_attrs))
falsepositives:
- Legitimate administrators using AdFind for authorized Active Directory queries.
level: high

data.rule_text:
title: Potential AdFind Execution
id: d234d10e-868c-4126-85da-ef0909f282d1
status: experimental
description: Detects execution of adfind.exe with suspicious command-line arguments commonly used for Active Directory reconnaissance.
author: Shakedown
date: '2026-10-27'
tags:
- attack.discovery
- attack.t1087
logsource:
  category: process_creation
  product: windows
detection:
  base_image:
    Image: adfind.exe
  cmd_showdel:
    CommandLine|contains: -showdel
  cmd_sdna_nosacl:
    CommandLine|contains:
    - -sdna
    - -nosacl
  cmd_security_desc:
    CommandLine|contains:
    - -sddl
    - -sddc
    - -owner*
  cmd_computed_attrs:
    CommandLine|contains:
    - parentrdn
    - objrdn
  condition: (base_image and (cmd_showdel or cmd_sdna_nosacl or cmd_security_desc or cmd_computed_attrs))
falsepositives:
- Legitimate administrators using AdFind for authorized Active Directory queries.
level: high
